## What is still open

- **Production PG17 cutover:** Maya approved PR #321 and confirmed the window has moved to **Sunday 22 November, 02:00–04:00 UTC**. Update the runbook and merge the PR; the Terraform plan preserves the read replica without destruction. [1][3][8]
- **Rollback rehearsal:** Test rollback on a fresh clone on Thursday 19 November, measuring duration and data loss. The cutover rehearsal saw 74 seconds of write downtime; switching back is not a simple rollback. [1]
- **Switchover coordination:** Give Lior 30 minutes’ notice to pause ingest consumers, and ping Daniel when the switchover starts. [7][9]
